title: 930. Find the Shortest Superstring

examples.explanation: No overlaps, so concatenation in any order is best.
Best overlaps chain all words into 16 characters.

hints: Precompute for every ordered pair how many trailing characters of the first equal the leading characters of the second.
Run a travelling-salesman style dynamic program over subsets: the state is (used set, last word) holding the best string so far.
Extend each state with every unused word using the precomputed overlap, keeping the shortest candidate (ties broken arbitrarily).
